column1: # Case 126 regression list: every interaction failure fixed once, and the test that keeps it fixed.
# tools/check-regressions.py fails `tools/check.sh` when a listed test is missing or renamed (CI runs it first).

column2: what must stay fixed
column4: test title (exact, as written in `it("…")`)

column2: no record from a later phase: the operation record, the histology, the follow-up do not exist before their phase
column4: records in the simulated timeline: before the review the operation record, the histology and the follow-up do not exist yet — no text from a later phase; in the review they do

column2: no specimen and no result after a failed acquisition; blocked with the reason, collected once
column4: the nurse shut out of OR 7: a blood count is assigned, blocked with the reason, no specimen and no result; the door opened, the same order is collected once and reported once

column2: the way to the device blocked: the order waits with the nurse's reason, then fulfilled
column4: the second run: the way to the machine blocked (the workroom door locked), the order waits with the nurse's reason; the door opened, it is fulfilled

column2: the anaesthetist of an anaesthetised patient never leaves by any path without relief
column4: no relief arranged: the anaesthetist of an induced patient may not leave — by a request to fetch, a direct move or a delegated task (every path goes through the one world-action guard)

column2: a structured hand-over in person; the new anaesthetist inherits the constraint
column4: asked to leave the anaesthetised patient, the anaesthetist first has the duty anaesthetist take over and records it

column2: traction falls with the assistant's hands; the window closes before the next step; save/resume agrees
column4: the assistant takes the grasper with its traction; saved and resumed, everything agrees; called away, the window closes before the next step

column2: every order its own instance: a second ECG never hidden by the first
column4: every order its own instance: a second ECG waiting for the machine is never hidden by the first, reviewed

column2: a reporting agent that times out or invents a finding is replaced by the template
column4: the second run: a reporting agent that times out, or writes what the tracing does not show, is replaced by the template — never an invented report

column2: case_status recommends only what would run
column4: case_status recommends only what would run: with the specimen still in, closure, emergence and the Sign Out are not 'next'

column2: a consultation is never a hint
column4: a consultation is not a hint: Dr Tanaka answers from the anaesthetic side, the hint count unchanged

column2: the Sign In states unknowns as unknown, never "confirmed"
column4: the Sign In states the unknowns as unknown — never 'confirmed'

column2: staff work on their own clock: the ECG's work and an alarm answered without a learner act
column4: the ECG ordered before induction is fetched, acquired, reported and reviewed on the staff's own clock — no act of the learner in between

column2: the responsible anaesthetist answers a new hypotension alarm at the patient, once
column4: hypotension under anaesthesia: the responsible anaesthetist answers the new critical alarm at the patient, once

column2: an operative cholangiogram is never ordered from the chart; a study the hospital cannot do waits with its reason
column4: never invented: a cholangiogram is acquired at the table, not ordered; a chest radiograph the hospital cannot take waits with its reason

column2: saved mid-handoff and restored: handed over exactly once
column4: saved mid-handoff and restored: the needle holder is handed over exactly once

column2: saved before the operation: the same obligations activate as in a run never interrupted
column4: saved before the operation (the scenario pending), reloaded: the same obligations activate as in a run never interrupted

column2: the count by item identity: an unresolved 4/5 caps the score; the Sign Out refused
column4: unresolved 4/5 and an attempted completion: closure is an unsafe progression no later count erases; the Sign Out is refused; the score is capped

column2: a record board belongs to the patient's room
column4: a record board belongs to the patient's room: OR 1's WHO board shows nothing of this patient and cannot sign them in

column2: the Time Out is one checklist action; after a reload the board's opens the operation once
column4: the Time Out is one checklist action: an early one leaves surgery locked; after a reload, the board's opens the operation once

column2: a read-back is the addressee's
column4: a read-back is the addressee's: the learner cannot answer a request said to the scrub nurse; one about another instrument reads back nothing

column2: under anaesthesia the patient cannot answer; speech returns with emergence
column4: under anaesthesia the patient cannot answer and nothing is credited; speech returns with emergence

column2: one run: the record, the WHO board and the score agree at every checklist step and at the end
column4: one run: the record, the WHO board and the score agree at every checklist step and at the end

column2: the in-world demonstration works the case through the room, every step valid, 100 %
column4: the in-world demonstration (offline) works the case through the room: the board's prerequisites met, every step valid, 100 %

column2: persistent action ids: on the tool result and events, resolved by get_action_feedback after a reload
column4: an operative step's persistent id: on its tool result and events, resolved by get_action_feedback — the same after a reload

column2: saved mid-task: the same order, nurse and reservation after a reload — no second task
column4: saved while the nurse's fetch is blocked, reloaded: the same order, the same nurse, one assignment — no second task; the way opened, fulfilled once

column2: the final six-phase scenario: ECG, relief, traction loss, playback integrity, save and resume, conversion
column4: pre-operative ECG → anaesthesia relief → traction loss → playback integrity → save and resume → conversion

column2: every member of staff holds a position and speaks from its own role card
column4: each member of staff holds a position, and speaks from that position's role card

column2: model-driven team members keep the closed loop and the world acts, in their own words
column4: characters.engine llm: the nurses hand the surgeon a needle holder, every move theirs — the same closed loop and acts, in their own words

column2: an ungrounded line from a member's model is refused; the loop still closes
column4: a member's line that states what nobody perceived is refused: the team's words are said, and the loop still closes

column2: an alarm while shut out: blocked travel said with its reason, never “at the patient”; arrival announced once, also after save and resume
column4: an alarm while the anaesthetist is shut out: the blocked walk is said with its reason, never “at the patient”; once the way opens they arrive and say so once — also after a save and resume

column2: the laparoscopic image needs a working camera and light, insufflation a working insufflator; a spare tower restores both
column4: the laparoscopic tower out of service: no gas, no picture — said and recorded; the spare tower fetched from the store brings both back

column2: on a manual clock the next timed event is named and a visible wait brings it
column4: a manual case clock: what the case waits for is said with its time, and waiting until it brings the report and the review

column2: a writer's conclusion without supporting observations is never released; release and review are separate acts
column4: a writer's unsupported diagnosis is never released: the template is, the refusal is on the record, and release and review are separate acts (the audit's counterexample)

column2: a tower failing with the scope in darkens and deflates the field at once; a spare restores it; a save and resume keeps both
column4: the working tower fails mid-operation: dark and deflated at once, a backup restores it; a save and resume keeps the dark field and the recovery

column2: a tower switched off supplies nothing; once the operation begins the circulating nurse switches it on; device, record and field agree
column4: the tower switched off: no picture and no gas; once the operation begins the circulating nurse switches it on — the device, the record and the field agree at each step

column2: a model line claiming the bedside while the record has the anaesthetist blocked is refused
column4: characters.engine llm: a model that says “I am at the bedside” while the anaesthetist is shut out is refused — the record's blocked line is said; once there, the model's own words are

column2: after a hand-over the anaesthetist responsible now signs the next report; a named reviewer stays theirs; kept after reload
column4: after the hand-over a new ECG is reviewed by the anaesthetist who took over, not the one who left; a reviewer named on the order stays theirs; both kept after a save and resume (the follow-up audit)

column2: an unsupported diagnosis appended to a writer's findings is never released
column4: a writer's unsupported diagnosis appended to genuine findings is never released: the service's template is (the follow-up audit)

column2: a writer cannot take the template's identity
column4: a writer's unsupported diagnosis labelled as the template is never released: the service's template is (the follow-up audit)

column2: a writer changing its input changes nothing: acquisition, report and reload agree
column4: a writer that changes what it was given and returns nothing changes nothing: the acquisition, the released report and a reload agree (the follow-up audit)

column2: the team works while the learner operates: alarm, hand-over, the next report signed by the responsible anaesthetist
column4: the learner keeps operating while the team works: an alarm and a hand-over with the surgery window open — who moves, who speaks, who signs the next report (the follow-up audit's acceptance test)
